In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of our infrastructure, ensuring that our web hosting products operate seamlessly and efficiently. Your responsibilities will include designing scalable solutions, automating deployment processes, and monitoring system health to prevent issues before they impact our users. The candidate will be responsible for developing advanced financial models and preparing professional valuation reports in accordance with IVS standards and the requirements of the Saudi Authority for Accredited Valuers (TAQEEM). In addition, the candidate will be responsible for executing Financial Due Diligence (FDD) projects. The role also involves direct client interaction and providing analytical support and insights. Key Responsibilities: Execute comprehensive business valuation, Financial Due Diligence (FDD) and Purchase Price Allocation (PPA) engagements in accordance with the highest applicable professional standards. Conduct in-depth financial, market, and industry analyses to support valuation outcomes. Develop advanced financial models using Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) methodologies, market multiples, and comparable transactions or asset-based approaches. Prepare accurate and clear valuation reports compliant with IVS standards and TAQEEM requirements. Present valuation findings to clients clearly and professionally, providing analytical insights and recommendations. Maintain ongoing coordination with the Manager and with internal and external stakeholders, to ensure high-quality and efficient workflow. Adhere to regulatory frameworks and local and international best professional practices. Stay up to date with leading local and global valuation practices and contribute insights for their application. Foster integration and collaboration with other technical departments and accredited valuers. Qualifications and Experience: Professional certifications such as ASA, CFA Level 2 or above, or equivalent (preferred). Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or business administration, or an equivalent field. Minimum of 4 years of experience in business valuation. Excellent command of both Arabic and English, spoken and written. Strong analytical skills with the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team and provide guidance to junior team members. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to deliver clear, analysis-based insights to clients and stakeholders.

review_candidates.title: Executive Assistant
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and business support within a fast-paced corporate environment. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and organizational skills, a high level of professionalism, and strong experience in preparing high-quality presentations, reports, and executive-level documents. The role requires someone who is confident, detail-oriented, discreet, and capable of managing multiple priorities effectively. Key Responsibilities Manage complex calendars, appointments, meetings, and scheduling while ensuring effective time management and prioritization. Coordinate internal and external meetings, including meeting invitations, agendas, logistics, and follow-up actions. Prepare professional and visually engaging PowerPoint presentations , reports, meeting materials, and executive documents. Transform information, data, and business updates into clear, structured, and executive-ready presentations. Draft, review, format, and proofread correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents. Manage emails, communications, and follow-ups professionally and efficiently. Prepare meeting agendas, take meeting minutes when required, and track action items to ensure timely completion. Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, and related itineraries when required. Maintain confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion. Support the preparation and organization of management meetings, workshops, events, and presentations. Coordinate with different departments and stakeholders to collect information, follow up on deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met. Maintain organized records, documents, reports, and administrative files. Anticipate administrative and business support requirements and proactively address them. Perform other administrative and coordination duties as required. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field. Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role , preferably within a corporate environment. Strong experience in preparing professional business presentations and executive-level materials. Excellent command of Microsoft PowerPoint , with the ability to create attractive, structured, and professional presentations. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and Excel . Excellent written and spoken English . Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent organizational, planning, and time-management abilities. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. High level of confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment. Professional appearance and demeanor, with confidence when interacting with senior stakeholders. Key Competencies Executive Support Presentation Development Business Communication Calendar & Meeting Management Stakeholder Coordination Organization & Planning Attention to Detail Confidentiality & Discretion Time Management Microsoft PowerPoint Microsoft Office English Communication

review_candidates.title: Customer Support / English ( C1 -B2 )
review_candidates.description: Company Description Raya Customer Experience (Raya CX) is a next-generation BPO and customer experience management provider serving clients across multiple industries. Since 2001, Raya CX has been a trusted partner for customer service, technical support, and global services for Fortune 1000 companies in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates from competitive and highly skilled labor markets to deliver high-quality outsourcing services. Raya CX offers integrated business process outsourcing solutions supported by advanced technology, robust strategies, and continuous improvement. The organization is committed to innovation and delivering consistent, reliable experiences for clients and their customers. Role Description The Customer Support / English (C1–B2) role is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm 1st 6 October. In this role, the team member responds to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, or other channels, providing accurate information and timely solutions. Day-to-day tasks include troubleshooting basic technical issues, documenting interactions, and following established procedures and service level agreements. The role also involves maintaining high customer satisfaction, escalating complex cases when needed, and collaborating with colleagues to ensure consistent service quality. The team member is expected to use strong English communication skills to support international customers and represent Raya CX professionally. Qualifications Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a service-oriented mindset and focus on problem resolution. Excellent Interpersonal Skills, including empathy, active listening, and clear communication in English at C1–B2 level. Ability to provide basic Technical Support and use Analytical Skills to understand issues and identify appropriate solutions. Proficiency in using computer systems, CRM tools, and common communication platforms. Ability to work on-site in Qesm 1st 6 October on a full-time schedule, including potential shifts, weekends, or holidays as required. Strong time management, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured processes and guidelines. Previous experience in customer service, BPO, or contact center environments is an advantage. High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in business, communications, or related fields is beneficial.
